title: Launch Publish saves the drafted website and first email as hidden drafts and never publishes or sends them.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/launch/review-io.ts:5-9 'it does not flip preferences.websitePublished ... kept as a draft under preferences.launchDraft and shown as such'; no reader of preferences.launchDraft outside review-io (rg launchDraft app components lib).

WHY IT MATTERS: A user reviews a site headline and an email, presses Publish, and neither goes anywhere; the 'Website' step stays required-and-undone, so the launch can't complete.

FIX DIRECTION: Write the headline/intro to the site layout seam and hand the email to the Space email drafts, then flip websitePublished.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: Publish now writes the website headline and intro to the site hero seam (preferences.siteHero) and switches the website on through setWebsitePublished (lib/launch/handoff-io.ts), only when the person wrote website words. The first email is handed to the Space email drafts as a draft and is never sent; the owner sends it from Marketing. lib/spaces/launch-draft.ts is the one reader of preferences.launchDraft and remembers the draft id so a second Publish makes no second draft. The website step is marked when it goes live.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
